$comment: Production dependencies allowed despite a licence outside the allowlist in scripts/licenses.ts. Keys are package names; a trailing * matches a prefix. Each entry needs a reason; keep this list short.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.reason: Anthropic terms; tolerated as in T3 Code; recheck before public release.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*.reason: Per-platform builds of @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (its bundled Claude Code binary), under the same Anthropic terms; same exception, recheck with it.

khroma.reason: MIT per its bundled license file (khroma@2.1.0/license); its package.json omits the licence field. Pulled in by mermaid (via @streamdown/mermaid).

caniuse-lite.reason: CC-BY-4.0 browser-support data (attribution kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), pulled in by next for apps/site; data, not code, and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

@img/sharp-libvips-*.reason: LGPL-3.0-or-later prebuilt libvips, loaded dynamically by sharp (an optional dependency of next) for apps/site's image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon.

@img/sharp-win32-arm64.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.

@img/sharp-win32-ia32.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.

@img/sharp-win32-x64.reason: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later Windows sharp build with bundled libvips, an optional dependency of next for apps/site image optimisation; unmodified, never copied into Polaris and never shipped in the Desktop App or Daemon. Same accepted exception as @img/sharp-libvips-*.
